parts.name: Air filter
parts.note: PR00: FILTER; AIR CLEANER €14.45 (8974995480, IE40 13 Mar 2026). IAM retail: Autodoc UK scraped 9 May 2026 — avg £32.57 → €38 @ 1.17. Min £11.00. parts.note: PR00: THERMOSTAT €10.31 ABC:A (multiple JP variants, IE40 13 Mar 2026). IAM retail: Autodoc est. €12. OEM-equiv (Gates/Wahler/Behr) retail ~€17.

parts.name: Brake pads (front)
parts.note: PR00: PAD KIT; CALIPER,DISC BRK,FRT €82.25 ABC:A (8975056801, TH) — IE40 13 Mar 2026. IAM retail: Autodoc UK scraped 9 May 2026 — avg £62.40 → €73 @ 1.17. Min £47.00. parts.note: PR00: VALVE; EGR €235.55 (PN 8983320160, ABC:A, TH, IE40 13 Mar 2026) — highest ABC rank, Thailand-sourced = current D-Max (4JJ3 engine). High confidence on PR00 (ABC:A confirmed).

lcv.footHtml: D-Max summary — AM prices: Autodoc UK scraped 9 May 2026, GBP × 1.17. PR00: IE40 13 Mar 2026. PMS COMPETITIVE Oil filter 0.91× DLR, fuel filter 0.74× DLR, air filter 0.84× DLR — ISZE beats AM market on all three at every price level. Previous estimates (Feb-Mar 2026) understated AM prices. Cabin filter exposed AM avg €11.9 vs PR00 €16.33 — ISZE above AM at ASC level (1.37×); DLR 3.0×. Loyalty risk on cabin filter. Brakes revised Pads 2.5× DLR (was 5.2× — old estimate was floor, real avg £62.40/€73). Disc 2.75× at AM floor (was 4.2×); AM avg near-parity with ISZE DLR at 1.05×. Clutch disc 4.1×, drum 3.4× unchanged. Shocks competitive Rear shock 1.16× DLR — near parity. Front 1.42×. EGR (2.9×) & ball joint (2.2×) exposed Drive-away risk unchanged. Glow plug (2.9×) above AM at ASC.

parts.name: Oil filter
parts.note: PR00: ELEMENT; OIL FILTER €14.45 ABC:A (8983282070, JP) + €14.25 ABC:C (8982984040, JP) — IE40 13 Mar 2026. Segment assignment estimated (JP-source, higher price vs D-Max €6.80). AM: Specialist truck filter (Mann/Mahle) est. €28–35, mid €30.

parts.name: Fuel filter (kit)
parts.note: PR00: ELEMENT KIT; FUEL FILTER €20.29 range in IE40 (estimated N-Series cluster). AM: Estimated medium-duty truck filter €30–40, mid €35. Confidence LOW — segment assignment not confirmed.

parts.name: Air filter
parts.note: PR00: FILTER/ELEMENT; AIR CLEANER range €17–45 in IE40; €31 used as representative N-Series estimate. AM: Larger truck element, fewer AM brands, est. €45–65, mid €55.

parts.name: Cabin filter

parts.name: Brake pads (front)
parts.note: PR00: PAD KIT; DISC BRK range in IE40 €81–103 for non-D-Max variants (JP-source). Weighted mid ~€92. AM: Ferodo/ATE medium truck pads est. €65–95, mid €80.

parts.name: Brake disc (front)
parts.note: PR00: ROTOR; DISC BRK range €158–166 JP-source cluster in IE40 13 Mar 2026. AM: Medium-duty truck disc, limited AM brands, est. €100–150, mid €125.

parts.name: Brake drum (rear)
parts.note: PR00: DRUM;BRAKE €144.58 (5423150330, JP) in IE40 — likely commercial truck drum. Lower cluster €108–127 used as N-Series estimate. AM: Estimated medium truck drum €90–130, mid €110. Confidence LOW.

parts.name: Clutch kit
parts.note: PR00: CLUTCH KIT €260.22 (1876101940, IE40 13 Mar 2026) — upper range consistent with N-Series 4HK1 engine. Range in IE40: €260–374 for larger kits. AM: Sachs/LuK medium-duty est. €250–350, mid €270. Confidence LOW — segment assignment estimated.

parts.name: Clutch disc (standalone)
parts.note: PR00: DISC; CLUTCH €84.47 (ABC:C, JP — eg. 8972599400, 8980370042, IE40 13 Mar 2026). Multiple matching PNs at this price point. AM: Sachs/Valeo standalone disc mid-duty, est. €80–110, mid €95. Medium confidence — JP price cluster consistent with N-Series 4HK1 range.

parts.name: EGR valve (4HK1)
parts.note: PR00: VALVE; EGR 4HK1 €151.32 (PNs 8982382470 / 8981795461 / 8982382473, ABC:C, JP, IE40 13 Mar 2026). Description explicitly names 4HK1 engine — the primary N-Series EU engine. AM: BorgWarner/Continental/Pierburg reman, est. €110–150, mid €130. Medium confidence.

parts.name: Shock absorber (front)
parts.note: PR00: Higher-cluster front shocks €42–46 (moderate qty). AM: Monroe/Sachs medium truck shock est. €70–100, mid €85. Confidence LOW.

parts.name: Shock absorber (rear)

mcv.footHtml: N-Series (MCV) notes: Lower AM competition Fewer aftermarket brands make medium-truck parts vs LCV — AM prices are higher, which reduces the competitiveness gap. Brakes still exposed Brake pads at DB/DLR level remain a risk. Shocks competitive at DB AM is thin enough that genuine is actually well-placed. ⚠ PR00 values = estimated from price clusters in simulation — confirm against EQ-HIT catalog. AM prices = estimates only (confidence LOW/MEDIUM).

parts.name: Brake disc (front)

parts.name: Brake drum (front/rear)

parts.name: Clutch kit / disc

parts.name: Shock absorber (front)

parts.name: Shock absorber (rear)

hcv.footHtml: F-Series (HCV) notes: Thin AM market = lower exposure Heavy truck AM parts are expensive and scarce — the competitiveness gap narrows significantly vs LCV. Discs & drums borderline Still 1.0–1.3× at DLR level in some categories. ⚠ All F-Series values are LOW confidence estimates. PR00 values are from the highest-price clusters in the simulation but model assignment is not confirmed. Use for directional analysis only.
